components.name: Native operation button
components.description: Compact Stop/Undo/Setup HTML buttons with native keyboard semantics and host-theme browser-chrome styling.
components.css: .ds-operation-button { appearance: none; box-sizing: border-box; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-width: 0; min-height: 24px; margin: 0; padding: 2px; border: 0; border-radius: 4px; background: transparent; color: inherit; font: inherit; line-height: inherit; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; } .ds-operation-button:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 10%, transparent); } .ds-operation-button:active { background: color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 16%, transparent); } .ds-operation-button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--zen-primary-color, AccentColor); outline-offset: 1px; } .ds-operation-button:disabled { opacity: .55; cursor: default; }

components.name: Connection field
components.description: Visible label, full-width field and explicit keyboard focus.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 6px; min-width: 0; } .ds-field > span { font-weight: 600; } .ds-control { box-sizing: border-box; width: 100%; min-width: 0; max-width: 100%; min-height: 36px; margin: 0; padding: 7px 10px; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 25%, transparent); border-radius: 6px; background: Field; color: FieldText; font: inherit; } .ds-control:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid AccentColor; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Domain rule chip
components.description: Advanced editor chip with drag affordance and a hoverable remove action.
components.css: .ds-domain-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 2px; padding: 2px 2px 2px 5px; background: color-mix(in srgb, AccentColor 12%, transparent); border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, AccentColor 30%, transparent); border-radius: 999px; font-size: 12px; font-family: ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace; white-space: nowrap; max-width: 100%; cursor: grab; user-select: none; } .ds-domain-chip:active { cursor: grabbing; } .ds-chip-remove { appearance: none; background: transparent; border: none; color: inherit; width: 16px; height: 16px; min-width: 16px; border-radius: 50%; cursor: pointer; font-size: 12px; line-height: 1; padding: 0; margin: 0; opacity: .55; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; flex: 0 0 auto; } .ds-chip-remove:hover { opacity: 1; background: color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 18%, transparent); }

components.name: Sidebar operation row
components.description: 32px transparent native sidebar feedback. Busy shows Stop; completion shows contextual Undo or Setup. Success dismisses after five seconds, pausing on hover/focus; the session Undo receipt survives visual dismissal.
components.html: Tidying 300 tabs…
components.css: .ds-operation { box-sizing: border-box; display: flex; align-items: center; min-width: 0; min-height: 32px; gap: 4px; padding: 2px 4px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; color: var(--toolbar-color, CanvasText); background: transparent; font: menu; font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.3; text-align: start; } .ds-message { flex: 1 1 auto; min-width: 0; margin: 0; overflow: hidden; white-space: nowrap; text-overflow: ellipsis; } .ds-operation-indicator { flex: none; width: 12px; height: 12px; } .ds-operation-button { appearance: none; box-sizing: border-box; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-width: 0; min-height: 24px; margin: 0; padding: 2px; border: 0; border-radius: 4px; background: transparent; color: inherit; font: inherit; line-height: inherit; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; } .ds-operation-button:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 10%, transparent); } .ds-operation-button:active { background: color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 16%, transparent); } .ds-operation-button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--zen-primary-color, AccentColor); outline-offset: 1px; } .ds-operation-button:disabled { opacity: .55; cursor: default; }

components.name: Native review surface
components.description: Open-dialog visual specimen. The app opens it modally, manages focus and commits only on Apply.
components.html: Review the proposed groups
components.css: .ds-review { position: relative; padding: 0; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 18%, transparent); border-radius: 12px; max-width: 640px; width: min(640px, 92vw); max-height: 80vh; background: Canvas; color: CanvasText; box-shadow: 0 14px 48px rgba(0,0,0,.35); overflow: hidden; font-size: 13px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; } .ds-review::backdrop { background: rgba(0,0,0,.45); }

narrative.overview:
OpenTabSort is a utility inside Zen browser chrome. Its established visual system inherits the host theme, system controls, and platform typography. It uses compact fields, restrained borders, and readable status messages rather than a separate brand palette.

The small AI setup and compact sidebar row share this native character with the retained editors. Provider-specific fields appear when relevant; advanced tools sit behind a native disclosure. Theme adaptation comes from CSS system colors and Zen variables, not fixed light/dark screen palettes.
keyCharacteristics: Compact controls with explicit keyboard focus.
A quiet settings surface and contextual sidebar feedback.
Native dialogs and disclosure, with bounded widths and wrapping content.

rules.name: Host Theme
rules.body: System colors and Zen variables remain the color authority; a screenshot's resolved hex values are not new palette tokens.

rules.name: Host Type
rules.body: Inherit Zen's interface font; use the platform menu font for the operation row and the existing monospace stack for rule chips.

rules.name: Purposeful Lift
rules.body: Keep the sidebar row and setup form flat; reserve the small shadow for fallback overlays and the larger existing shadow for modal review.

dos: Do inherit system colors and Zen variables so the user's theme stays authoritative.
Do retain visible focus, native labels, masked API-key fields, and polite status announcements.
Do use the documented control, row, and review shapes for their existing roles.
Let settings fields and action rows wrap within the dialog; keep sidebar feedback to one line with full tooltip and accessible text.
donts: Don't replace the inherited theme with a new fixed brand palette or downloadable font.
Don't promote advanced rule chips or category editors into the simple connection form.
Don't hide an active Stop control or delete the session Undo receipt when feedback disappears.
Don't present decorative motion when reduced motion is requested.
